svg.title: Effort levels: time against quality
svg.desc: Final engine at High, Medium, Low and Sol-Attn 0.5: wall time, PSNR against High, and the actual pictures.
svg.text: Final engine (c7aa76e), cold CLI, median wall time. Quality is PSNR against High with the same prompt and seed.
identical to High: the canvas is too
small for Sol-Attn, so it stays dense

PSNR 24.7 dB: same scene and pose,
At 2048² Sol-Attn stays dense, so Medium and Sol 0.5 give High's picture in High's time. At 4096² a sparse step takes about 13.1 s
against 24.5 s for a dense one. Every repeat of a setting gave a bit-identical picture.
